citations.claim: initial state at rest; commanded velocity toward waypoint far below requires large force
first violating step: controller force 105.53 exceeds fmax 81.179

counterfactual.change: Lowered controller kp from 28.608 to 10.0 only; commanded force drops to 44.09 < fmax 81.179 so no violation.

explanation: Velocity-error law F=kp*m*(vcmd direction - v) plus seeded sensor noise demands ~105.5 N on step 1, exceeding fmax 81.18 N. The commanded force is applied/unreported without clamping to fmax, so controller_force_limit is violated immediately. Lowering kp alone removes the violation, confirming unclamped gain-driven demand is the cause.
vision_note: The controller-driven body in red starts near the top center far from the green waypoint in the lower right and shows almost no displacement between step 0 and step 1. No escape, penetration, or tunneling is visible; the violation is an internal excessive commanded force with no motion signature.
